name: Katsuragi Naomasa
source:
Fukujurou's rookie in charge of rooms.

Naomasa ends up causing trouble out of everything he does, although he does try his best. He is currently aiming to become a worthy room caretaker after being influenced by Yunoha. Much to everyone's surprise, he possibly has a sinister side to him.
